data.title: Large reasoning models are autonomous jailbreak agents
data.author: Thilo Hagendorff, Erik Derner, Nuria Oliver
data.summary: Abstract Jailbreaking – bypassing built-in safety mechanisms in AI models – has traditionally required complex technical procedures or specialized human expertise. In this study, we show that the persuasive capabilities of large reasoning models (LRMs) simplify and scale jailbreaking, converting it into an inexpensive activity accessible to non-experts. We evaluated the capabilities of four LRMs (DeepSeek-R1, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Grok 3 Mini, Qwen3 235B) to act as autonomous adversaries conducting multi-turn conversations with nine widely used target models. LRMs received instructions via a system prompt, before proceeding to planning and executing jailbreaks with no further supervision. We performed extensive experiments with a benchmark of harmful prompts covering several sensitive domains. This setup yielded an overall jailbreak success rate across all model combinations of 97.14%. Our study reveals an alignment regression, in which LRMs can systematically erode the safety guardrails of other models, highlighting the urgent need to further align frontier models not only to resist jailbreak attempts, but also to prevent them from being co-opted into acting as jailbreak agents.
data.title_cn: 大型推理模型是自主越狱代理
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：越狱——绕过人工智能模型中内置的安全机制——传统上需要复杂的技术程序或专门的人类专业知识。在这项研究中，我们证明了大型推理模型（LRM）的说服能力可以简化和扩展越狱，将其转变为非专家也可以进行的廉价活动。我们评估了四种 LRM（DeepSeek-R1、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Grok 3 Mini、Qwen3 235B）作为自主对手与九种广泛使用的目标模型进行多轮对话的能力。 LRM 通过系统提示接收指令，然后在没有进一步监督的情况下继续计划和执行越狱。我们对涵盖多个敏感领域的有害提示基准进行了广泛的实验。此设置在所有型号组合中的整体越狱成功率为 97.14%。我们的研究揭示了一种对齐回归，其中 LRM 可以系统地侵蚀其他模型的安全护栏，这突显了迫切需要进一步对齐前沿模型，不仅可以抵抗越狱尝试，还可以防止它们被选为越狱代理。

data.title: Effect of sonication and protease inhibitors on Elisa quantification of selected proteins in bovine udder tissue homogenates
data.author: Adrianna Szprynca, Michał Czopowicz, Magdalena Zalewska, Tomasz Sakowski, Jarosław Kaba, Emilia Bagnicka
data.summary: The protocols for preparing ELISA samples vary in terms of the use of mechanical homogenization (MH) alone or the additional use of protease inhibitors (PI) and/or sonication (S). It is unclear whether the type of protocol can affect the final protein yield; thus, we evaluated how different preparation methods and their combination affect the alpha-casein (CSN1), lactoferrin (LTF), and alkaline phosphatase (ALP) concentrations in udder parenchyma using a sandwich ELISA, and tested whether the udder health state (coagulase-positive staphylococcal ​​infection) affects the protocol efficacy. Samples from 22 cows (11 healthy, 11 infected) were processed using the four protocols. PI and S reduced protein concentrations, with the combination of MH + PI+S giving the lowest ​​values for all three proteins. Unlike CSN1, ALP was the most sensitive to processing. CSN1 levels were higher in infected samples, while lactoferrin and ALP were not influenced by infection. All preparation methods affected the protein levels, irrespective of health state. The highest protein concentrations were obtained using MH alone. Our findings highlight the need for careful optimization and standardization of sample preparation to ensure reliable and reproducible ELISA results.
data.title_cn: 超声处理和蛋白酶抑制剂对牛乳房组织匀浆中选定蛋白质的 Elisa 定量的影响
data.abstract_cn: 制备 ELISA 样品的方案在单独使用机械匀浆 (MH) 或额外使用蛋白酶抑制剂 (PI) 和/或超声处理 (S) 方面有所不同。目前尚不清楚实验方案的类型是否会影响最终的蛋白质产量；因此，我们使用夹心 ELISA 评估了不同的制备方法及其组合如何影响乳房实质中的 α-酪蛋白 (CSN1)、乳铁蛋白 (LTF) 和碱性磷酸酶 (ALP) 浓度，并测试了乳房健康状态（凝固酶阳性葡萄球菌感染）是否影响方案功效。使用四种方案处理来自 22 头奶牛（11 头健康，11 头感染）的样本。 PI 和 S 降低了蛋白质浓度，MH + PI+S 的组合使所有三种蛋白质的值最低。与 CSN1 不同，ALP 对处理最敏感。受感染样本中 CSN1 水平较高，而乳铁蛋白和 ALP 不受感染影响。无论健康状况如何，所有制备方法都会影响蛋白质水平。单独使用 MH 可获得最高的蛋白质浓度。我们的研究结果强调需要仔细优化和标准化样品制备，以确保可靠且可重复的 ELISA 结果。

data.title: A high-performance training-free pipeline for robust random telegraph signal characterization via adaptive wavelet-based denoising and Bayesian digitization methods
data.author: Tonghe Bai, Ayush Kapoor, Na Young Kim
data.summary: Random telegraph signal (RTS) analysis is increasingly important for characterizing meaningful temporal fluctuations in physical, chemical, and biological systems. The simplest RTS arises from discrete stochastic switching events between two binary states, quantified by their transition amplitude and dwell times in each state. Quantitative analysis of RTSs provides valuable insights into microscopic processes such as charge trapping in semiconductors. However, analyzing RTS becomes considerably complex when signals exhibit multi-level structures or are corrupted by background white or pink noise. To address these challenges and support high-throughput RTS characterization, we propose a modular, training-free signal processing pipeline that integrates adaptive dual-tree complex wavelet transform (DTCWT) denoising with a lightweight Bayesian digitization strategy. The adaptive DTCWT denoiser incorporates autonomous parameter selection rules for its decomposition level and thresholds, optimizing white noise suppression without manual tuning. Complementing this stage, our Bayesian digitizer formulates RTS level assignment as a probabilistic latent-state inference problem incorporating temporal regularization without iterative optimization, effectively resolving binary trap states even under residual notorious background pink noise. Quantitative benchmarking on large synthetic datasets with known ground truth demonstrates improved RTS reconstruction accuracy, trap-state resolution, and dwell-time estimation across diverse noise regimes and multi-trap scenarios, while achieving up to 83$$\times$$ speedups over classical and neural baselines. Qualitative validation on experimental RTS data when no ground truth is available illustrates practical usability and flexibility for real-time or large-scale analysis in real measurement settings. Together, the proposed framework establishes a scalable and reproducible foundation for autonomous RTS analysis and systematic benchmarking, with potential to support future extensions toward more complex and device-specific RTS studies.
data.title_cn: 通过基于自适应小波的去噪和贝叶斯数字化方法实现稳健的随机电报信号表征的高性能免训练管道
data.abstract_cn: 随机电报信号 (RTS) 分析对于表征物理、化学和生物系统中有意义的时间波动越来越重要。最简单的 RTS 源于两个二元状态之间的离散随机切换事件，通过它们的转变幅度和每个状态的停留时间来量化。 RTS 的定量分析为半导体中的电荷捕获等微观过程提供了宝贵的见解。然而，当信号呈现多级结构或被背景白噪声或粉噪声破坏时，分析 RTS 就会变得相当复杂。为了应对这些挑战并支持高通量 RTS 表征，我们提出了一种模块化、免训练的信号处理管道，它将自适应双树复小波变换 (DTCWT) 去噪与轻量级贝叶斯数字化策略集成在一起。自适应 DTCWT 降噪器结合了分解级别和阈值的自主参数选择规则，无需手动调整即可优化白噪声抑制。作为这一阶段的补充，我们的贝叶斯数字化仪将 RTS 级别分配制定为概率潜在状态推理问题，结合了时间正则化而无需迭代优化，即使在残留的臭名昭著的背景粉红噪声下也能有效解决二进制陷阱状态。对具有已知地面事实的大型合成数据集进行的定量基准测试表明，RTS 重建精度、陷阱状态分辨率以及跨不同噪声状态和多陷阱场景的驻留时间估计得到了改善，同时比经典和神经基线实现了高达 83$$\times$$ 的加速。在没有真实数据的情况下对实验 RTS 数据进行定性验证，说明了在实际测量设置中进行实时或大规模分析的实际可用性和灵活性。总之，所提出的框架为自主 RTS 分析和系统基准测试建立了可扩展和可重复的基础，有可能支持未来向更复杂和特定于设备的 RTS 研究扩展。

data.title: A network analysis of the associations between COVID-19-related variables and health across sex, age and educational levels among Ghanaian youths
data.author: Jiajia Ye, I-Hua Chen, Po-Ching Huang, Emma Sethina Adjaottor, Frimpong-Manso Addo, Ishmael Ronald Ahorsu, Mark D. Griffiths, Wanqing Lin, Daniel Kwasi Ahorsu, Chung Ying Lin
data.summary: The COVID-19 pandemic has had far-reaching impacts on global health, affecting not only physical well-being but also exacerbating mental health issues. The present study investigated the associations between COVID-19-related variables and health outcomes across different sex, age, and education levels. The cross-sectional survey study was conducted from June to August 2022, comprising 1,326 participants aged 12 to 28 years in Ghana. Participants completed psychometric measures assessing fear of COVID-19, psychological distress, perceived stigma, self-stigma, preventive behaviors, believing COVID-19 information, vaccination acceptance, and quality of life. Network analysis indicated that COVID-19-related stress was positively associated with fear of COVID-19, psychological distress, and COVID-19-related self-stigma. The fear of COVID-19 was positively associated with preventive COVID-19 behaviors, COVID-19-related self-stigma, and believing COVID-19 information, while psychological distress was positively associated with COVID-19-related self-stigma but negatively associated with both physical and mental quality of life. Physical quality of life was negatively associated with COVID-19-related perceived stigma and COVID-19 vaccine acceptance. These network structures varied across sex, age, and educational levels. COVID-19-related stress had the highest centrality across four indices. In sum, the present study highlighted the interconnectedness of COVID-19-related variables and health factors among young people in Ghana. COVID-19-related stress appeared to be a pivotal determinant of psychological well-being. Stress related to the COVID-19 pandemic served as a key determinant of psychological well-being. The differences in network structures across sex, age, and education levels highlighted the importance of tailored health interventions. Further research employing longitudinal study designs and targeting diverse populations are needed to observe the dynamic associations between health-related variables over time.
data.title_cn: 对加纳青年中不同性别、年龄和教育水平的 COVID-19 相关变量与健康之间关系的网络分析
data.abstract_cn: COVID-19 大流行对全球健康产生了深远影响，不仅影响身体健康，还加剧了心理健康问题。本研究调查了不同性别、年龄和教育水平的 COVID-19 相关变量与健康结果之间的关联。这项横断面调查研究于 2022 年 6 月至 8 月进行，涉及加纳 1,326 名 12 至 28 岁的参与者。参与者完成了心理测量测量，评估对 COVID-19 的恐惧、心理困扰、耻辱感、自我耻辱、预防行为、对 COVID-19 信息的相信、疫苗接种接受度和生活质量。网络分析表明，与 COVID-19 相关的压力与对 COVID-19 的恐惧、心理困扰和与 COVID-19 相关的自我耻辱呈正相关。对covid-19的恐惧与covid-19的预防性行为、covid-19相关的自我耻辱和相信covid-19信息呈正相关，而心理困扰与covid-19相关的自我耻辱呈正相关，但与身心生活质量呈负相关。身体生活质量与 COVID-19 相关的耻辱感和 COVID-19 疫苗接受程度呈负相关。这些网络结构因性别、年龄和教育水平而异。与 COVID-19 相关的压力在四个指数中具有最高的中心性。总之，本研究强调了加纳年轻人中与 COVID-19 相关的变量和健康因素的相互关联性。与 COVID-19 相关的压力似乎是心理健康的关键决定因素。与 COVID-19 大流行相关的压力是心理健康的关键决定因素。不同性别、年龄和教育水平之间网络结构的差异凸显了量身定制的健康干预措施的重要性。需要采用纵向研究设计并针对不同人群进行进一步的研究，以观察健康相关变量之间随时间的动态关联。

data.title: Assessment of cognitive load through photoplethysmography and bioimpedance responses during mental arithmetic tasks
data.author: Dang Nguyen Huynh, Thao Nguyen Tran, Khang Thanh Tran, Nguyen Khoa Le, Cao Dang Le, Huu-Xuan Mai, Quang-Linh Huynh, Trung-Hau Nguyen
data.summary: Accurate assessment of cognitive load is vital in cognitive research and human–machine interaction. This study investigates a multimodal approach for classifying graded cognitive load levels using cardiovascular signals derived from photoplethysmography (PPG) and impedance plethysmography (IPG). Data were collected from 15 healthy adults performing mental arithmetic tasks of increasing difficulty (Rest, Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3). Carotid PPG was used as a global indicator of cerebral perfusion, while frontal IPG captured localized changes in regional blood volume. Machine learning algorithms, including Decision Trees, Random Forest, and XGBoost, were applied to discriminate between workload levels. Among these models, Random Forest achieved the highest performance, reaching 96% accuracy in subject-dependent classification. Subject-independent accuracy was lower (66%), reflecting substantial inter-subject variability. IPG-derived features were among the most influential contributors to workload discrimination, highlighting the role of localized neurovascular responses to cognitive demand. These findings support the potential of PPG–IPG fusion as a noninvasive and physiologically grounded technique for continuous monitoring of cognitive workload.
data.title_cn: 在心算任务中通过光电体积描记法和生物阻抗反应评估认知负荷
data.abstract_cn: 准确评估认知负荷对于认知研究和人机交互至关重要。本研究研究了一种多模式方法，利用光电体积描记法 (PPG) 和阻抗体积描记法 (IPG) 产生的心血管信号对分级认知负荷水平进行分类。数据收集自 15 名健康成年人，他们执行难度逐渐增加的心算任务（休息、1 级、2 级和 3 级）。颈动脉 PPG 被用作脑灌注的整体指标，而额叶 IPG 则捕获局部血容量的局部变化。应用机器学习算法（包括决策树、随机森林和 XGBoost）来区分工作负载级别。在这些模型中，随机森林取得了最高的性能，在主题相关分类中达到了 96% 的准确率。独立于受试者的准确度较低（66%），反映了受试者间的巨大差异。 IPG 衍生的特征是对工作负荷歧视最有影响力的因素之一，凸显了局部神经血管反应对认知需求的作用。这些发现支持 PPG-IPG 融合作为一种无创且基于生理学的技术，用于持续监测认知负荷的潜力。

data.title: Plasmonic artificial inspector for herbal medicines via surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy and deep learning
data.author: Hongdoo Kim, Jemin Lee, Sung Won Kim, Hyung Gyu Park
data.summary: For the safety monitoring of herbal medicines (HMs), HM inspectors carry out an organoleptic examination before acceptance for market supply. The organoleptic test processes are often regarded as labor-intensive, thus calling for efficient and reliable aids. Here, we propose a plasmonic artificial HM inspector based on a collaboration between surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS) and deep learning (DL). Inherently, a SERS spectrum of an HM specimen contains several peaks that match bioactive compounds in the sample, yielding so-called fingerprint information of HM. Besides, its rapid, few-second data-acquisition speed lends the SERS-DL analysis adaptability to a complementary inspection method for organoleptic examination. Regarding the accuracy and reliability of this new method, the synergistic integration of SERS with DL attains ~95% accuracy in labor-saving differentiation of 35 HM species with similar appearances or of the same genus. Our SERS-DL-based analysis can potentially aid the organoleptic HM inspection and help upgrade the HM database, along with images and other analytical chemistry data.
data.title_cn: 通过表面增强拉曼光谱和深度学习进行草药等离子人工检查
data.abstract_cn: 为了对草药 (HM) 进行安全监控，HM 检查员在接受市场供应之前进行感官检查。感官测试过程通常被认为是劳动密集型的，因此需要高效、可靠的辅助设备。在这里，我们提出了一种基于表面增强拉曼光谱 (SERS) 和深度学习 (DL) 之间协作的等离子体人工 HM 检查器。本质上，HM 样本的 SERS 光谱包含几个与样品中生物活性化合物相匹配的峰，产生所谓的 HM 指纹信息。此外，其快速、几秒的数据采集速度使 SERS-DL 分析能够适应感官检查的补充检查方法。关于这种新方法的准确性和可靠性，SERS 与 DL 的协同集成在 35 个外观相似或同一属的 HM 物种的省力区分中达到了约 95% 的准确率。我们基于 SERS-DL 的分析可能有助于感官 HM 检查，并帮助升级 HM 数据库以及图像和其他分析化学数据。

data.title: Changes in retinal oxygen saturation before and after femtosecond LASIK in adult myopic individuals with anisometropia
data.author: Shanshan Ge, Xiaoqi Ma, Xiuli Zhou, Yuehua Zhou
data.summary: Abstract This study aimed to investigate the relationship between myopia and retinal vascular oxygen saturation, after accounting for optical factors and individual variations. This was a prospective, observational, single-center study. Adults with anisometropia were included. All the participants underwent femtosecond-assisted laser in situ keratomileusis (FS-LASIK), and before and after the surgery, all the patients underwent the examination of visual acuity, intraocular pressure (IOP), spherical equivalent (SE), average keratometry (K), central corneal thickness, and retinal oximeter. A total of 196 adult patients with myopic anisometropia were enrolled. The SE of the less myopic eyes before surgery was − 3.89 ± 3.24 D, which was significantly higher than that of the more myopic eyes − 6.75 ± 3.10 D ( p < 0.001). The retinal arterial oxygen saturation (SaO 2 ) of the less myopic eyes was 94.08 ± 1.61%, which was significantly higher than that of the more myopic eyes 93.36 ± 1.74% ( p = 0.003). After FS-LASIK, the SaO 2 of the less myopic eyes (93.29 ± 1.72%) remained significantly higher than that of the more myopic eyes (92.76 ± 1.83%) ( p = 0.038). In the multivariate regression analysis, the postoperative SaO 2 was still significantly negatively correlated with axial length (AL) ( B = -0.252, P = 0.009). After excluding optical factors and individual variations, SaO 2 remains negatively correlated with AL. Myopia exerts an optical magnification effect on SaO 2 .
data.title_cn: 成人屈光参差近视患者飞秒LASIK手术前后视网膜氧饱和度的变化
data.abstract_cn: 摘要：本研究旨在在考虑光学因素和个体差异后，探讨近视与视网膜血管氧饱和度之间的关系。这是一项前瞻性、观察性、单中心研究。患有屈光参差的成年人也被包括在内。所有受试者均接受飞秒辅助激光原位角膜磨镶术（FS-LASIK），手术前后均进行视力、眼压（IOP）、球镜当量（SE）、平均角膜曲率（K）、中央角膜厚度、视网膜血氧计检查。共有 196 名成年近视屈光参差患者入组。近视程度较低的眼睛术前的SE为− 3.89 ± 3.24 D，明显高于近视程度较高的眼睛的SE - 6.75 ± 3.10 D ( p < 0.001)。近视程度较低的眼睛的视网膜动脉血氧饱和度（SaO 2 ）为94.08±1.61%，显着高于近视程度较高的眼睛的93.36±1.74%（p = 0.003）。 FS-LASIK 后，近视程度较低的眼睛 (93.29 ± 1.72%) 的 SaO 2 仍然显着高于近视程度较高的眼睛 (92.76 ± 1.83%) (p = 0.038)。多因素回归分析显示，术后SaO 2 与眼轴长度（AL）仍呈显着负相关（B=-0.252，P=0.009）。排除光学因素和个体差异后，SaO 2 仍与AL呈负相关。近视对SaO 2 产生光学放大作用。

data.title: Identifying the causal effects of photovoltaic installations on grassland productivity using double machine learning: a case study in inner Mongolia
data.author: Zhangqi Yu, Zuopei Zhang, Runsong Yuan
data.summary: Driven by the global energy transition and the “dual-carbon” goals, the rapid deployment of large-scale photovoltaic (PV) installations has profoundly reshaped land surface processes. This transformation is particularly pronounced in arid and semi-arid grassland ecosystems, where the potential ecological impacts of PV construction remain both critical and controversial. However, most existing studies rely primarily on correlation analyses, which fail to accurately identify the true causal effects of PV installations on ecosystem productivity. In this study, we focus on typical grasslands in Inner Mongolia, China, integrating multi-source remote sensing datasets including MODIS net primary productivity (NPP), meteorological, topographic, and anthropogenic factors. A double machine learning (DML) approach is employed within a quasi-experimental framework to quantify the ecological causal effects of PV construction. The results reveal that the average treatment effect (ATE) of PV installation on grassland NPP is − 0.00427 (p > 0.05), indicating a statistically insignificant overall impact. Nevertheless, substantial spatial heterogeneity exists: approximately 62.1% of PV sites exhibit positive ecological effects, whereas 37.9% show negative ones. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) based analysis further identifies that the spatial variability of PV-induced ecological effects is primarily regulated by environmental factors such as distance to water bodies, mean annual temperature, potential evapotranspiration, soil moisture, and drought index. This study demonstrates the effectiveness and advantages of the DML framework in identifying causal ecological interventions. The findings provide a scientific basis for implementing “ecology-prioritized, site-specific” PV development strategies and highlight the necessity of integrating ecological baseline assessments and spatially precise management to achieve a synergy between energy security and ecosystem conservation.
data.title_cn: 使用双机器学习识别光伏装置对草地生产力的因果影响：内蒙古的案例研究
data.abstract_cn: 在全球能源转型和“双碳”目标的推动下，大规模光伏装置的快速部署深刻重塑了地表过程。这种转变在干旱和半干旱草原生态系统中尤为明显，光伏建设的潜在生态影响仍然至关重要且存在争议。然而，大多数现有研究主要依赖于相关性分析，无法准确识别光伏安装对生态系统生产力的真正因果影响。在本研究中，我们以中国内蒙古典型草原为研究对象，整合了MODIS净初级生产力（NPP）、气象、地形和人为因素等多源遥感数据集。在准实验框架内采用双机器学习（DML）方法来量化光伏建设的生态因果效应。结果表明，光伏安装对草地NPP的平均处理效果（ATE）为−0.00427（p>0.05），表明总体影响在统计上不显着。然而，仍然存在显着的空间异质性：大约 62.1% 的光伏站点表现出积极的生态效应，而 37.9% 的光伏站点表现出负面的生态效应。基于 SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) 的分析进一步表明，光伏引起的生态效应的空间变异性主要受环境因素的调节，例如距水体的距离、年平均温度、潜在蒸散量、土壤湿度和干旱指数。本研究证明了 DML 框架在识别因果生态干预措施方面的有效性和优势。研究结果为实施“生态优先、因地制宜”的光伏发展战略提供了科学依据，凸显了将生态基线评估与空间精准管理相结合，实现能源安全与生态系统保护协同发展的必要性。

data.title: Biopolymer-based multilayer capsules for protection and controlled release of Pseudomonas fluorescens T17-4 and Bacillus velezensis VRU1
data.author: Roohallah Saberi Riseh, Fariba Fathi
data.summary: Plant growth-promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR) are widely recognized as sustainable agricultural inputs because they enhance nutrient availability, reduce reliance on chemical fertilizers, and improve soil and plant health. However, their field performance is often limited by reduced viability and stability under environmental stresses. This study aimed to develop and compare double-layer and multilayer polysaccharide–protein–based encapsulation systems to improve the protection, long-term stability, and controlled release of PGPR. Pseudomonas fluorescens T17-4 and Bacillus velezensis VRU1 were encapsulated using an alginate–whey protein isolate core, with successive outer layers of apricot gum and pectin to form double-layer and multilayer capsules. Mesoporous silica nanoparticles were added to further reinforce the capsule structure. The multilayer encapsulation system outperformed the double-layer formulation, showing higher encapsulation efficiency (> 90%), improved structural integrity, enhanced long-term stability with over 90% bacterial viability after six months, and a more controlled release profile. These findings demonstrate that multilayer polysaccharide–protein encapsulation is an effective strategy for protecting PGPR and ensuring their sustained delivery, highlighting its potential for developing robust biofertilizers in sustainable agriculture.
data.title_cn: 基于生物聚合物的多层胶囊，用于保护和控制释放荧光假单胞菌 T17-4 和贝莱斯芽孢杆菌 VRU1
data.abstract_cn: 促进植物生长的根际细菌（PGPR）被广泛认为是可持续的农业投入品，因为它们可以提高养分的利用率，减少对化肥的依赖，并改善土壤和植物的健康。然而，它们的现场性能通常受到环境压力下活力和稳定性降低的限制。本研究旨在开发和比较双层和多层多糖-蛋白质封装系统，以改善 PGPR 的保护、长期稳定性和控制释放。使用海藻酸盐-乳清分离蛋白核心对荧光假单胞菌 T17-4 和贝莱斯芽孢杆菌 VRU1 进行封装，并连续外层采用杏胶和果胶，形成双层和多层胶囊。添加介孔二氧化硅纳米颗粒以进一步增强胶囊结构。多层封装系统的性能优于双层配方，显示出更高的封装效率（> 90%）、改善的结构完整性、增强的长期稳定性（六个月后细菌活力超过 90%）以及更受控的释放曲线。这些发现表明，多层多糖-蛋白质封装是保护 PGPR 并确保其持续输送的有效策略，突显了其在可持续农业中开发强大的生物肥料的潜力。

data.title: Differential effects of biologically and chemically synthesized copper oxide nanoparticles on artemisinin biosynthesis gene expression in Artemisia absinthium
data.author: Sepideh Mahjouri, Rana Madadi Rad, Saeed Jafarirad, Roshanak Tarrahi, Fatemeh Sabaghfartash, Aytak Kiani, Mohammad Firouzandeh Gharehatlou, Sepideh Entezar Faraj, Reyhaneh Bakhshi, Morteza Kosari-Nasab
data.summary: Artemisinin is an effective antimalarial compound produced by Artemisia absinthium. Due to its low natural yields, it is crucial to investigate novel strategies to enhance biosynthesis of artemisinin. The impact of copper oxide nanoparticles (CuO NPs) on the expression of important genes involved in the biosynthesis of artemisinin was examined in this work. CuO NPs were synthesized using both green microwave irradiation and conventional wet chemical methods. Application of a variety of techniques, including XRD, DLS, FESEM, EDX, and FTIR confirmed the proper synthesis of CuO NPs. Nodal segments of A. absinthium were treated with CuO NPs at 2 and 4 ppm in MS medium and gene expression was analyzed using qRT-PCR. The results showed significant increases in key biosynthetic genes, including FDS, ADS, CYP71AV1, DBR2, and ALDH1. Specifically, a high level of expression of several transcripts associated with ADS, CYP71AV1, and DBR2 was observed in the cultures treated with 4 ppm of green synthesized CuO NPs (with 2.03-, 2.00-, and 1.83-fold increases, respectively) and 2 ppm of chemically synthesized CuO NPs (with 2.35-, 1.86-, and 2.34-fold increases, respectively), in comparison with the control. Additionally, there was only a slight increase in RED1, a gene that redirects metabolic flow away from artemisinin production. It can be concluded that CuO NPs, particularly those synthesized with green method, can be considered as potent nano-elicitors, enhancing the biosynthesis of artemisinin by modifying gene expression. This study demonstrates how nanotechnology can be used to increase pharmaceutical compound production of medicinal plants in a sustainable manner.
data.title_cn: 生物合成和化学合成的氧化铜纳米粒子对苦艾青蒿素生物合成基因表达的差异影响
data.abstract_cn: 青蒿素是由苦艾产生的有效抗疟化合物。由于其自然产量较低，研究增强青蒿素生物合成的新策略至关重要。这项工作研究了氧化铜纳米粒子（CuO NPs）对青蒿素生物合成中重要基因表达的影响。 CuO NPs 采用绿色微波辐射和传统湿化学方法合成。包括 XRD、DLS、FESEM、EDX 和 FTIR 在内的多种技术的应用证实了 CuO 纳米粒子的正确合成。在 MS 培养基中用 2 ppm 和 4 ppm 的 CuO NP 处理苦艾的节段，并使用 qRT-PCR 分析基因表达。结果显示关键生物合成基因显着增加，包括 FDS、ADS、CYP71AV1、DBR2 和 ALDH1。具体而言，在用 4 ppm 绿色合成 CuO NP（分别增加 2.03、2.00 和 1.83 倍）和 2 ppm 化学合成 CuO NP（增加 2.35、1.86 和 2.34 倍）处理的培养物中观察到与 ADS、CYP71AV1 和 DBR2 相关的几种转录物的高水平表达。分别），与对照相比。此外，RED1（一种将代谢流从青蒿素生产中转移出来的基因）仅略有增加。可以得出结论，CuO NPs，特别是那些用绿色方法合成的，可以被认为是有效的纳米引发剂，通过改变基因表达来增强青蒿素的生物合成。这项研究展示了如何利用纳米技术以可持续的方式增加药用植物的药物化合物产量。

data.title: Aniracetam restores the excitation-inhibition balance of neurotransmitters in the prefrontal cortex of mice with ADHD
data.author: Jie Cui, Xiao-Li Sun, Shuo Shi, Hui Bai, Wei Zhang, Wan-Jun Bai
data.summary: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is the most prevalent neurodevelopmental disorder in childhood and a common chronic condition among school-aged children. However, the pharmacological mechanisms and pathophysiology of ADHD remain incompletely elucidated. Transmembrane α-amino-3-hydroxy-5-methyl-4-isoxazolepropionic acid (AMPA) receptor regulatory protein γ-8 (TARP γ-8, also known as calcium voltage-gated channel auxiliary subunit γ8) functions as an auxiliary subunit of AMPA receptors. Previous studies suggest that mice lacking the TARP γ-8 protein may display hyperactivity, impulsivity, and memory deficits, which are hallmarks of ADHD. The nootropic compound aniracetam effectively mitigates ADHD-like symptoms, including hyperactivity, impulsivity, anxiety, cognitive deficits, and memory impairment, observed in adolescent TARP γ-8 knockout (KO) mice. This investigation explored the therapeutic potential of aniracetam and its underlying molecular mechanisms using TARP γ-8 KO mice as an ADHD model. Through cerebral microdialysis coupled with liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS) analysis, we identified perturbations in neurotransmitter metabolism in the ADHD model of TARP γ-8 KO mice. Real-time quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR) was employed to detect alterations in the expression of key receptor and transporter genes. The results indicate that aniracetam can alleviate ADHD-related behavioral deficits by modulating the excitatory-inhibitory neurotransmitter systems through the modulation of glutamate receptor, γ-Aminobutyric Acid receptor, and monoamine neurotransmitter transporter expression. These findings in a TARP γ-8-deficient ADHD model support further investigation into aniracetam as a potential therapeutic intervention for ADHD, providing novel molecular targets and a theoretical framework for the pharmacological management of ADHD.
data.title_cn: 阿尼西坦恢复 ADHD 小鼠前额皮质神经递质的兴奋抑制平衡
data.abstract_cn: 注意力缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）是儿童时期最常见的神经发育障碍，也是学龄儿童中常见的慢性疾病。然而，ADHD 的药理学机制和病理生理学仍未完全阐明。跨膜α-氨基-3-羟基-5-甲基-4-异恶唑丙酸（AMPA）受体调节蛋白γ-8（TARP γ-8，也称为钙电压门控通道辅助亚基γ8）作为AMPA受体的辅助亚基发挥作用。先前的研究表明，缺乏 TARP γ-8 蛋白的小鼠可能表现出多动、冲动和记忆缺陷，这些都是 ADHD 的标志。在青少年 TARP γ-8 敲除 (KO) 小鼠中观察到，促智化合物阿尼西坦可有效减轻 ADHD 样症状，包括多动、冲动、焦虑、认知缺陷和记忆障碍。本研究使用 TARP γ-8 KO 小鼠作为 ADHD 模型，探讨了阿尼拉西坦的治疗潜力及其潜在分子机制。通过脑微透析结合液相色谱-串联质谱 (UPLC-MS/MS) 分析，我们确定了 TARP γ-8 KO 小鼠 ADHD 模型中神经递质代谢的扰动。采用实时定量 PCR (RT-qPCR) 来检测关键受体和转运蛋白基因表达的变化。结果表明，茴拉西坦可以通过调节谷氨酸受体、γ-氨基丁酸受体和单胺神经递质转运蛋白的表达来调节兴奋-抑制神经递质系统，从而缓解 ADHD 相关的行为缺陷。 TARP γ-8 缺陷 ADHD 模型中的这些发现支持进一步研究阿尼拉西坦作为 ADHD 潜在治疗干预措施，为 ADHD 的药理学管理提供新的分子靶点和理论框架。

data.title: An upper-limb teleoperation exoskeleton with stepless arm-length parameterization and adaptive force-triggered impedance blending
data.author: Puyi Zeng, Yuqin Xu, Shaobin Zheng, Shisheng Zhang, Chi Zhu, Ruisen Huang, Yang Zhang
data.summary: Remote control technology is a core means of ensuring personnel safety in high-risk scenarios such as deep-sea exploration and nuclear facility maintenance. However, existing exoskeleton teleoperations suffer from drawbacks such as discretized arm length adjustment, insufficient dynamic control adaptability, and limited execution accuracy. This study proposes a reproducible unilateral upper limb exoskeleton teleoperation system, employing a 7-DOF active drive architecture (3 DOF for the shoulder, 1 DOF for the elbow, and 3 DOF for the wrist) to match the kinematic characteristics of the human upper limb. The system integrates four key designs: low-inertia, high-reaction joints (weight reduction using carbon fiber and aluminum alloy), an ergonomic alignment mechanism adapted to upper arm circumferences of 74.8–105.7 mm, a 6-DOF passive compensation module for scapulothoracic wall motion, and a digital adaptive arm length adjustment mechanism (achieving stepless adjustment and dynamic updating of the URDF model through a sliding rheostat). The control strategy adopts a hybrid scheme of “master-end position impedance control and slave-end force-based impedance feedback,” modeled based on the Lagrange equation, introducing adaptive weighted coefficient balance trajectory tracking and force feedback compliance, and verifying global asymptotic stability using Lyapunov functions and the LaSalle invariance principle. The experiment used the Franka Panda robot as a platform, based on a Linux real-time kernel and ROS architecture, with joint position data transmitted via 500 Hz Ethernet. Master-slave teleoperation achieved a mirrored reproduction of a spatial figure-eight trajectory, and gravity compensation effectively offset the load. Ablation experiments showed that the peak contact force in group C3 decreased to 7.41 N (a 68.8% reduction from baseline); the sum of squared residuals in arm length measurement was $$<0.002\,\,{\rm mm}^2$$, and the deviation after multiple wearing cycles was $$\le 2.5$$ mm. The experiment confirmed that the system overcomes the adaptability and robustness deficiencies of traditional systems, achieving high-precision master-slave synchronization and load compensation. It meets the teleoperation needs of high-risk scenarios and can also provide a rehabilitation training platform for hemiplegic patients, demonstrating broad application prospects.
data.title_cn: 具有无级臂长参数化和自适应力触发阻抗混合的上肢远程操作外骨骼
data.abstract_cn: 远程控制技术是深海勘探、核设施维护等高风险场景下保障人员安全的核心手段。然而，现有的外骨骼遥控操作存在臂长调整离散化、动态控制适应性不足、执行精度有限等缺点。本研究提出了一种可重复的单侧上肢外骨骼远程操作系统，采用 7 自由度主动驱动架构（肩部 3 个自由度、肘部 1 个自由度、腕部 3 个自由度）来匹配人类上肢的运动学特征。该系统集成了四个关键设计：低惯量、高反力关节（采用碳纤维和铝合金减轻重量）、适应74.8-105.7 mm上臂周长的人体工学对准机构、肩胸壁运动的六自由度被动补偿模块和数字自适应臂长调节机构（通过滑动变阻器实现URDF模型的无级调节和动态更新）。控制策略采用“主端位置阻抗控制和从端基于力的阻抗反馈”的混合方案，基于拉格朗日方程建模，引入自适应加权系数平衡轨迹跟踪和力反馈柔顺，并利用Lyapunov函数和拉萨尔不变原理验证全局渐近稳定性。实验以Franka Panda机器人为平台，基于Linux实时内核和ROS架构，通过500 Hz以太网传输关节位置数据。主从遥操作实现了空间八字轨迹的镜像再现，重力补偿有效抵消了载荷。消融实验表明，C3 组的峰值接触力下降至 7.41 N（较基线下降 68.8%）；臂长测量残差平方和为$$<0.002\,\,{\rm mm}^2$$，多次佩戴后的偏差为$$\le 2.5$$ mm。实验证实，该系统克服了传统系统适应性和鲁棒性方面的缺陷，实现了高精度的主从同步和负载补偿。满足高危场景的远程操作需求，还可以为偏瘫患者提供康复训练平台，展现出广阔的应用前景。

data.title: Eco-friendly synthesis of gold nanoparticles using Gracilaria gracilis with antioxidant potential and biocompatibility
data.author: Kimia Ramezani Moghadam, Sedigheh Gharbi, Aliakbar Haddad-Mashadrizeh, Mohammad Ehsan Taghavizadeh Yazdi
data.summary: Gold nanoparticles have emerged as promising materials for drug delivery systems due to their unique biological and physicochemical properties. This study presents the synthesis and biological application of gold nanoparticles using red algae (Gracilaria gracilis) for the first time, offering a cost-effective and eco-friendly method. The biosynthesized nanoparticles (NPs) were characterized using various analytical techniques, including Transmission electron microscopy (TEM), Field emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM), Energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDX), UV-Vis-spectroscopy, Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD), Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and Zeta-potential analysis. The UV-Vis spectrum confirmed the successful green synthesis of gold NPs. FESEM and TEM images revealed the spherical morphology of these NPs with an average size of 10.49 nm, and they were uniformly dispersed. The high gold content was further confirmed by EDX analysis. The crystalline size of the nanoparticles, as calculated from XRD data, was about 39.5 nm. The presence of bioactive compounds on the nanoparticles’ surface was verified by FTIR analysis, which also correlated with a decrease in Zeta-potential values. The antioxidant activity was evaluated using the DPPH assay, which revealed dose-dependent radical scavenging effects. Cytotoxicity analysis demonstrated that the biosynthesized gold nanoparticles exhibited no significant toxicity toward human fibroblast cells. Furthermore, these nanoparticles showed excellent biocompatibility, indicating their potential applicability as effective alternatives in biomedical, pharmaceutical, and food industries.
data.title_cn: 使用具有抗氧化潜力和生物相容性的江蓠环保合成金纳米颗粒
data.abstract_cn: 由于其独特的生物和物理化学特性，金纳米颗粒已成为药物输送系统有前途的材料。这项研究首次提出了利用红藻（Gracilaria gracilis）合成金纳米颗粒并进行生物应用，提供了一种经济高效且环保的方法。使用各种分析技术对生物合成的纳米粒子（NP）进行表征，包括透射电子显微镜（TEM）、场发射扫描电子显微镜（FESEM）、能量色散X射线分析（EDX）、紫外-可见光谱、粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）和Zeta电位分析。紫外-可见光谱证实金纳米粒子的绿色合成成功。 FESEM 和 TEM 图像显示这些纳米颗粒呈球形形貌，平均尺寸为 10.49 nm，且分散均匀。 EDX分析进一步证实了高金含量。根据 XRD 数据计算，纳米颗粒的晶体尺寸约为 39.5 nm。通过 FTIR 分析验证了纳米颗粒表面存在生物活性化合物，这也与 Zeta 电位值的降低相关。使用 DPPH 测定评估抗氧化活性，揭示了剂量依赖性自由基清除作用。细胞毒性分析表明，生物合成的金纳米粒子对人成纤维细胞没有表现出明显的毒性。此外，这些纳米粒子表现出优异的生物相容性，表明它们作为生物医学、制药和食品工业的有效替代品的潜在适用性。

data.title: Tribological performance of UV treated nanodiamond reinforced polyurethane nanocomposites through Taguchi and machine learning technique
data.author: Markapudi Bhanu Prasad, Borhen Louhichi, P. S. Rama Sreekanth, A. Praveen Kumar, Joy Djuansjah, Santosh Kumar Sahu, It Ee Lee, Qamar Wali
data.summary: The objective of the current work is to investigate the tribological properties of nanodiamond (ND) reinforced polyurethane (PU) composite and examine the impact of UV irradiation on these properties. The experiments were optimized using the Taguchi design and ANOVA, while machine learning (ML) techniques were applied to predict the tribological performance. The study uses the Taguchi design of experiments (DOE) with an L27 orthogonal array to assess the effects of sliding distance (500–1500 m), sliding speed (100–300 rpm), load (10–30 N), composition (pure PU, 0.2 wt% ND, 0.5 wt% ND), and UV irradiation time (0, 200, 400 h) on wear rate and coefficient of friction (COF). The results show that incorporating 0.5 wt% ND significantly enhances PU performance, reducing the wear rate to 0.018 × 10⁻³ g/m and achieving a COF of 0.253 under optimal conditions of 30 N load, 0 h of UV irradiation, and 300 rpm. ANOVA reveals that composition and UV irradiation time are the most influential factors, contributing 52.52% and 35.46% to wear rate, and 22.18% and 50.57% to COF, respectively. Machine learning models, including Support Vector Regression (SVR), linear regression, and XGBoost, were used for performance prediction, with XGBoost providing the highest accuracy (R²/MSE = 0.99/0.000003 for wear rate, 0.98/0.00023 for COF). The findings highlight the potential for developing enhanced polyurethane nanocomposites with improved wear resistance for applications in industries such as automotive and aerospace, under varying tribological and environmental conditions.
data.title_cn: 通过田口和机器学习技术研究紫外线处理的纳米金刚石增强聚氨酯纳米复合材料的摩擦学性能
data.abstract_cn: 当前工作的目的是研究纳米金刚石（ND）增强聚氨酯（PU）复合材料的摩擦学性能，并检查紫外线照射对这些性能的影响。使用田口设计和方差分析对实验进行了优化，同时应用机器学习 (ML) 技术来预测摩擦学性能。该研究使用田口实验设计 (DOE) 和 L27 正交阵列来评估滑动距离 (500–1500 m)、滑动速度 (100–300 rpm)、负载 (10–30 N)、成分（纯 PU、0.2 wt% ND、0.5 wt% ND）和紫外线照射时间（0、200、400 h）对磨损率和系数的影响摩擦力（COF）。结果表明，掺入 0.5 wt% ND 显着增强了 PU 性能，在 30 N 负载、0 h 紫外线照射和 300 rpm 的最佳条件下，将磨损率降低至 0.018 × 10^3 g/m，COF 达到 0.253。方差分析显示，成分和紫外线照射时间是影响最大的因素，分别对磨损率贡献 52.52% 和 35.46%，对 COF 贡献 22.18% 和 50.57%。机器学习模型，包括支持向量回归 (SVR)、线性回归和 XGBoost，用于性能预测，其中 XGBoost 提供最高的准确度（磨损率 R²/MSE = 0.99/0.000003，COF 0.98/0.00023）。研究结果凸显了开发增强型聚氨酯纳米复合材料的潜力，该复合材料具有更高的耐磨性，可在不同的摩擦学和环境条件下应用于汽车和航空航天等行业。

data.title: A novel method of C-VBQ score and CT-HU as risk predictors for cage subsidence after short level ACDF
data.author: Qiang Zhang, Zequn Zhang, Rongzhi Ma, Yuan Xue
data.summary: We used a novel technique to measure subsidence after short-level anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF) with plate and screw fixation. And we aimed to evaluate cage subsidence by using cervical vertebral bone quality (C-VBQ) score and CT-HU. Quantitative assessment of vertebral bone quality was performed through two complementary methods: C-VBQ scoring and CT Hounsfield unit measurements, with their correlation established using Pearson’s analysis. The research methodology incorporated multiple statistical techniques, beginning with linear regression to examine demographic influences on C-VBQ values. For subsidence risk evaluation, all imaging datasets were rigorously compiled and subjected to multivariate regression analysis to identify significant contributing factors. The predictive validity of these factors was subsequently verified through ROC curve analysis, providing a robust assessment of their clinical utility. 112 patients who underwent short-level (≤ 2) ACDF were enrolled in this study, and 29 patients (25.89%) with cage subsidence were found. The subsidence group demonstrated significantly higher C-VBQ values (3.10 ± 0.22) compared to the non-subsidence cohort (2.70 ± 0.36, P < 0.001). Multivariate analysis identified the C-VBQ score as the sole independent predictor of cage subsidence following ACDF, achieving an 83.9% predictive accuracy. CT-HU value exhibited a significant inverse relationship with C-VBQ scores (P < 0.001). Univariate regression analysis identified age as the only parameter significantly correlated with C-VBQ values (P < 0.001). The inverse relationship between C-VBQ and CT-HU suggests its validity as a bone quality measure. Importantly, C-VBQ proved clinically valuable for identifying subsidence risk in 1–2 level ACDF procedures.
data.title_cn: C-VBQ 评分和 CT-HU 作为短水平 ACDF 后笼子沉降风险预测的新方法
data.abstract_cn: 我们使用一种新技术来测量短节段颈椎前路椎间盘切除融合术 (ACDF) 后的下沉情况，并采用钢板和螺钉固定。我们的目的是通过颈椎骨质量（C-VBQ）评分和CT-HU来评估融合器下沉。椎骨质量的定​​量评估通过两种互补的方法进行：C-VBQ 评分和 CT Hounsfield 单位测量，并使用 Pearson 分析建立它们的相关性。该研究方法结合了多种统计技术，从线性回归开始检查人口统计对 C-VBQ 值的影响。对于沉降风险评估，所有成像数据集均经过严格编译并进行多元回归分析，以确定重要的影响因素。随后通过 ROC 曲线分析验证了这些因素的预测有效性，为其临床效用提供了可靠的评估。本研究纳入112例接受短水平（≤2）ACDF的患者，发现29例（25.89%）患者出现笼下沉。与非沉降组 (2.70 ± 0.36, P < 0.001) 相比，沉降组表现出显着更高的 C-VBQ 值 (3.10 ± 0.22)。多变量分析确定 C-VBQ 评分是 ACDF 后笼子沉降的唯一独立预测因子，预测准确度为 83.9%。 CT-HU值与C-VBQ评分呈显着负相关（P<0.001）。单变量回归分析确定年龄是唯一与 C-VBQ 值显着相关的参数 (P < 0.001)。 C-VBQ 和 CT-HU 之间的负相关表明其作为骨质量测量的有效性。重要的是，C-VBQ 被证明对于识别 1-2 级 ACDF 程序中的下陷风险具有临床价值。

data.title: Comparative performance of activated sludge and waste stabilization ponds for the removal of pollutants and pathogens in full-scale wastewater treatment plants in Egypt
data.author: Marwa A. Kamel, Neveen Magdy Rizk, Mahmoud Gad, Gamal K. Hassan, Aly Al-Sayed, Mariam E. Fawzy, Mohamed Azab El-Liethy, Ibrahim Ahmed Hamza
data.summary: The discharge of inadequately treated wastewater poses serious public health and environmental risks worldwide. In this study, the performance of two wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) was evaluated for their ability to remove pathogenic viruses and bacteria, organic and nitrogen compounds, bacteriophages, and bacterial indicators. WWTP-A employs activated sludge treatment technology, whereas WWTP-B utilizes waste stabilization ponds (WSP). The removal rates of chemical oxygen demand (COD) and biological oxygen demand (BOD) were higher in WWTP-A than in WWTP-B, indicating the limited efficiency of the WSP system in treating heavily contaminated sewage. In WWTP-A, bacterial removal rates ranged between 3.9log10 for Listeria spp. and 6.2 log10 for Escherichia coli (E. coli), while in WWTP-B, removal ranged from 3.2 log10 for Pseudomonas aeruginosa to 5.3 log10 Fecal Streptococci. The viral reduction rate by WWTP-A ranged from 0.9 log10 for crAssphage to 3 log10 for human adenovirus (HAdV), whereas in WWTP-B, viral removal ranged between 0.8 log10 for somatic coliphages (SOMCPH) and 3 log10 for crAssphage. CrAssphage exhibited significant influent–effluent reduction in both WWTP-A and WWTP-B (Wilcoxon test, p < 0.05). In contrast, significant HAdV reduction was observed only in WWTP-A, SOMCPH only in WWTP-B, while RoV showed no significant reduction in either system. These findings highlight limitations in the ability of conventional treatment processes to consistently remove viral contaminants from treated effluent and underscore the need for improved management strategies to enhance effluent quality.
data.title_cn: 埃及大型污水处理厂中活性污泥和废物稳定池去除污染物和病原体的性能比较

data.title: Facile sol–gel fabrication of MnOx/Graphite nanostructured electrodes for sustainable produced water treatment
data.author: Mohadese Ghasemi, Neda Afsham, Narges Fallah
data.summary: In this study, manganese oxide films were successfully deposited on Graphite sheets using a sol-gel dip-coating method. The films were subsequently employed as anode electrodes for the electrochemical oxidation of produced water (PW) in the polishing stage of the treatment. Electrodes were fabricated by optimizing key parameters affecting the synthesis of manganese oxide colloids, including precursor concentration, withdrawal speed, and calcination temperature, through a dip-coating process on Graphite sheets followed by thermal treatment and calcination. The electrochemical performance of the electrodes was evaluated through cyclic voltammetry (CV) and their chemical oxygen demand (COD) removal efficiency during the electrochemical oxidation of PW. A comparison of the electrochemical efficiencies of fabricated electrodes under different fabrication conditions in the treatment process showed that the optimal conditions included an initial manganese acetate concentration of 0.3 M, five coating layers, a withdrawal speed of 5.5 mm/min, and calcination at 300 °C for 60 min, which led to the formation of a crystal structure of Mn2O3. The results showed the specific capacity of 92.161 mF/cm2, 86.96% COD removal at 30 mA/cm2 after 120 min and an estimated lifetime of 500 h. The structural and morphological characterization of the optimized electrode using X-ray diffraction (XRD) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM) confirmed the uniform deposition of Mn2O3 nanoparticles on the Graphite substrate. The findings indicate that the proposed MnOx electrode exhibits both high efficiency and stability, making it a promising candidate for the electrochemical oxidation of produced water as well as for applications in electrochemical supercapacitors.
data.title_cn: MnOx/石墨纳米结构电极的易溶胶-凝胶制造，用于可持续采出水处理
data.abstract_cn: 在这项研究中，使用溶胶-凝胶浸涂方法成功地将氧化锰薄膜沉积在石墨片上。随后，这些薄膜被用作阳极电极，用于在处理的抛光阶段对采出水（PW）进行电化学氧化。通过在石墨片上进行浸涂工艺，然后进行热处理和煅烧，优化影响氧化锰胶体合成的关键参数（包括前体浓度、提拉速度和煅烧温度）来制造电极。通过循环伏安法（CV）评估电极的电化学性能及其在PW电化学氧化过程中的化学需氧量（COD）去除效率。处理过程中不同制备条件下制备的电极电化学效率的比较表明，最佳条件为醋酸锰初始浓度为0.3 M，涂层层数为5，拉出速度为5.5 mm/min，在300 ℃下煅烧60 min，形成Mn2O3晶体结构。结果显示，比容量为 92.161 mF/cm2，120 分钟后在 30 mA/cm2 下 COD 去除率为 86.96%，预计使用寿命为 500 小时。使用 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 和扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 对优化电极的结构和形态表征证实了 Mn2O3 纳米颗粒在石墨基底上的均匀沉积。研究结果表明，所提出的 MnOx 电极表现出高效率和稳定性，使其成为采出水电化学氧化以及电化学超级电容器应用的有希望的候选者。

data.title: Dual-loop proportional control for high-precision induction brazing of thin-walled aluminum waveguides
data.author: Vadim Tynchenko, Dmitry Martysyuk, Sergei Kurashkin, Vladimir Nelyub, Aleksei Borodulin, Andrei Gantimurov, Ivan Malashin
data.summary: This study presents an automated induction brazing system for thin-walled aluminum waveguide assemblies, integrating dual-loop control with real-time positional feedback. Two proportional control strategies were evaluated: a baseline single-loop heating-rate controller and an enhanced dual-loop configuration incorporating active inductor realignment based on thermal asymmetry. The single-loop system, operating at 20 Hz, achieved an average absolute temperature error of 3.4 °C with a 92% success rate, but exhibited sensitivity to workpiece–inductor gap variations, leading to inter-element temperature deviations exceeding 15 °C under moderate misalignments. To address this, a secondary feedback loop was introduced to dynamically correct flange-to-tube temperature differentials, improving thermal uniformity across the brazing zone. Full-scale validation on 120 assemblies across four geometric classes demonstrated that the dual-loop system reduced average temperature error to 2.1 °C, limited peak temperature spread to 8 °C, and increased yield to 97%. The control architecture features distinct bandwidth separation for power and positional loops, minimizing cross-coupling. A modular C++ software environment synchronizes multi-source data streams—including pyrometry, manipulator kinematics, power metrics, and video analytics—with real-time KPI tracking and long-term logging to an SQL-based historian. These results highlight the potential of feedback-driven control architectures in precision thermal joining, and suggest pathways for future enhancements using adaptive or fractional-order control algorithms.
data.title_cn: 薄壁铝波导高精度感应钎焊双环比例控制
data.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了一种用于薄壁铝波导组件的自动感应钎焊系统，将双环控制与实时位置反馈集成在一起。评估了两种比例控制策略：基线单回路加热速率控制器和增强型双回路配置，其中结合了基于热不对称的有源电感器重新对准。单回路系统在 20 Hz 下运行，平均绝对温度误差为 3.4 °C，成功率为 92%，但对工件 - 电感器间隙变化很敏感，导致在中等失准情况下元件间温度偏差超过 15 °C。为了解决这个问题，引入了辅助反馈回路来动态校正法兰与管的温差，从而提高整个钎焊区域的热均匀性。对四个几何类别的 120 个组件进行的全面验证表明，双环系统将平均温度误差降低至 2.1 °C，将峰值温差限制至 8 °C，并将良率提高至 97%。该控制架构具有功率环路和位置环路的独特带宽分离，最大限度地减少交叉耦合。模块化 C++ 软件环境将多源数据流（包括高温测量、机械臂运动学、功率指标和视频分析）与实时 KPI 跟踪和长期记录同步到基于 SQL 的历史记录。这些结果凸显了反馈驱动控制架构在精密热连接中的潜力，并提出了使用自适应或分数阶控制算法进行未来增强的途径。

data.title: A satellite based machine learning approach for estimating high resolution daily average air temperature in a megacity in Brazil
data.author: Aina Roca-Barceló, Rochelle Schneider, Monica Pirani, Alessandro Sebastianelli, Frédéric B. Piel, Paolo Vineis, Adelaide Cassia Nardocci, Daniela Fecht
data.summary: Spatiotemporally resolved ambient temperature data are essential for environmental epidemiology, especially in urban areas where temperature can vary sharply over short distances, influencing population exposure. Additionally, heat distribution often reflects built environment patterns and may correlate with existing social and environmental disparities. Continuous temporal records at high spatial resolution are, however, often lacking, especially in low- and middle-income countries. We developed a generalizable tree-based machine learning approach to estimate daily mean temperatures at 500 × 500 m resolution using São Paulo, a megacity in Brazil, as a case study, to demonstrate its utility in highly urbanized settings with a heterogeneous urban fabric and unevenly distributed temperature monitoring stations. We trained a Random Forest model using open-access remote sensing data, along with derived products, and temperature measurements from 43 ground stations. To prevent overfitting and select relevant features, we employed a forward feature selection algorithm with target-oriented (spatial) cross-validation. Hyperparameter tuning was performed using grid search approach. The model was validated through ten-fold station-based cross-validation and an external hold-out dataset. The model demonstrated strong performance (RMSERF = 0.80; R2RF = 0.95), with slightly reduced accuracy in rural areas (R2rural = 0.91; R2urban = 0.95). Compared to traditional multilinear approaches (RMSEMLR = 1.02; R2MLR = 0.92), the Random Forest model outperformed, likely due to its ability to better capture microclimates and complex relationships between data sources. This 500 × 500 m daily temperature dataset is the first of its kind in South America, with the São Paulo pipeline and data freely accessible. The approach is adaptable to other regions with appropriate retraining and validation, enabling high-resolution exposure assessments.
data.title_cn: 基于卫星的机器学习方法，用于估计巴西大城市的高分辨率日平均气温
data.abstract_cn: 时空解析的环境温度数据对于环境流行病学至关重要，特别是在城市地区，那里的温度在短距离内可能急剧变化，影响人口暴露。此外，热量分布通常反映建筑环境模式，并可能与现有的社会和环境差异相关。然而，经常缺乏高空间分辨率的连续时间记录，特别是在低收入和中等收入国家。我们开发了一种基于树的通用机器学习方法，以巴西特大城市圣保罗为案例研究，以 500 × 500 m 分辨率估算日平均温度，以证明其在城市结构异构和温度监测站分布不均的高度城市化环境中的实用性。我们使用开放获取的遥感数据以及衍生产品和 43 个地面站的温度测量数据来训练随机森林模型。为了防止过度拟合并选择相关特征，我们采用了具有面向目标（空间）交叉验证的前向特征选择算法。使用网格搜索方法进行超参数调整。该模型通过十倍基于站点的交叉验证和外部保留数据集进行了验证。该模型表现出强大的性能（RMSERF = 0.80；R2RF = 0.95），但农村地区的准确性略有下降（R2rural = 0.91；R2urban = 0.95）。与传统的多线性方法（RMSEMLR = 1.02；R2MLR = 0.92）相比，随机森林模型表现优异，可能是因为它能够更好地捕捉微气候和数据源之间的复杂关系。这个 500 × 500 m 的每日温度数据集是南美洲首个此类数据集，可免费访问圣保罗管道和数据。该方法可通过适当的再培训和验证适用于其他地区，从而实现高分辨率暴露评估。

data.title: Examining speakers’ subjective and bio-behavioral responses to audience-induced social-evaluative threat via immersive VR
data.author: Sue Lim, Ralf Schmälzle, Gary Bente
data.summary: Success in public speaking hinges on engaging an audience, which involves a high-stakes social interaction process that remains a significant source of anxiety and stress for many. Using a virtual-reality (VR)-based experimental paradigm, we tested how speakers delivering scientific talks perceive and respond to supportive vs. unsupportive audiences. We collected behavioral (gaze, paralinguistics, motion expressiveness/openness), physiological (heart rate, electroencephalography, breathing rate, pupil dilation), and self-report measures to assess audience effects. The unsupportive audience elicited greater negative affect, arousal, and anxiety, and higher perceived cognitive and social effort. Physiologically and behaviorally, speaking to the unsupportive audience decreased the speaking rate. Acoustic analyses further indicated greater emotional arousal and vocal dominance in the unsupportive condition. These findings highlight VR combined with physiological measurement as a powerful approach for investigating audience effects and social-communication processes, with clear implications for augmenting social intelligence and communication skills.
data.title_cn: 通过沉浸式 VR 检查演讲者对观众引发的社会评价威胁的主观和生物行为反应
data.abstract_cn: 公开演讲的成功取决于吸引听众，这涉及高风险的社交互动过程，这仍然是许多人焦虑和压力的重要来源。使用基于虚拟现实 (VR) 的实验范式，我们测试了发表科学演讲的演讲者如何感知和回应支持与不支持的观众。我们收集了行为（注视、副语言、动作表现力/开放性）、生理（心率、脑电图、呼吸频率、瞳孔扩张）和自我报告测量来评估观众效果。不支持的观众会引发更大的负面情绪、唤醒和焦虑，以及更高的感知认知和社交努力。从生理和行为上来说，向不支持的听众讲话会降低讲话速度。声学分析进一步表明，在不支持的情况下，情绪唤起程度更高，声音占主导地位。这些发现强调，虚拟现实与生理测量相结合是研究受众效应和社交沟通过程的有力方法，对增强社交智力和沟通技巧具有明显的影响。

data.title: Uncertainty analysis of physical-based carbon accounting in cotton T-shirt manufacturing
data.author: Emmanuel Olugbemi, Natanael Favero Bolson
data.summary: Abstract The textile sector contributes significantly to global greenhouse gas emissions, yet product-level carbon accounting in this industry remains constrained by data gaps and methodological uncertainty. This study quantifies the uncertainty embedded in process-based carbon accounting for the cradle-to-gate production of a cotton T-shirt. We evaluated secondary activity data and emission factors using a pedigree matrix across five data quality indicators: precision, completeness, and temporal, geographical, and technological representativeness. The total cradle-to-gate carbon footprint was $${1.37}\,\hbox {kg}\,\hbox {CO}_{2}\hbox {e}$$ per T-shirt, with an overall uncertainty of ±13.81 %. Fabric production was the largest source of emissions and uncertainty, contributing over 60 % of total emissions and nearly 70 % of total uncertainty, driven by energy-intensive processes such as weaving, dyeing, and sanforising. Yarn spinning was a secondary hotspot, while the sewing stage had comparatively minor impacts. The results show significant variation in data reliability across production stages and highlight the need for improved primary data, updated emission factors, and harmonised databases to strengthen the robustness and comparability of process-based carbon accounting in the textile sector.
data.title_cn: 棉T恤制造中物理碳核算的不确定性分析
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 纺织行业对全球温室气体排放做出了重大贡献，但该行业产品层面的碳核算仍然受到数据差距和方法不确定性的限制。这项研究量化了棉质 T 恤从摇篮到大门生产过程中基于流程的碳核算中的不确定性。我们使用谱系矩阵评估了二次活动数据和排放因子，涵盖五个数据质量指标：精度、完整性以及时间、地理和技术代表性。每件 T 恤从摇篮到大门的总碳足迹为 $${1.37}\,\hbox {kg}\,\hbox {CO}_{2}\hbox {e}$$，总体不确定性为 ±13.81%。在织造、染色和预缩等能源密集型工艺的推动下，织物生产是最大的排放源和不确定性来源，占总排放量的 60% 以上，占总不确定性的近 70%。纺纱是次要热点，而缝纫阶段的影响相对较小。结果显示，不同生产阶段的数据可靠性存在显着差异，并强调需要改进原始数据、更新排放因子和统一数据库，以加强纺织行业基于流程的碳核算的稳健性和可比性。

data.title: Single-shot incoherent imaging with extended and engineered field of view using coded phase apertures
data.author: Sai Deepika Sure, Jawahar Prabhakar Desai, Joseph Rosen
data.summary: A large field of view of an optical system is needed for many applications, and optical systems with high magnification often suffer from a limited field of view due to the limited size of the camera sensor. This study proposes a novel technique for engineering the field of view of an optical system without compromising the magnification. In the proposed method, an object response pattern is recorded on a camera by introducing a coded phase mask (CPM) in the imaging system. The coded phase mask is a multiplexing of N distinct scattering phases, where N − 1 represents the number of isolated object areas to be brought within the field of view. Each scattering phase yields a point spread function of a unique sparse dot pattern on the camera. With the introduction of a coded phase mask, the objects’ images are brought within the region of the camera sensor, which, without the CPM, would have remained outside the inherent field of view of the system. To reconstruct the original object plane with N objects at their respective locations, the zero-padded object response pattern is deconvolved with the system’s zero-padded and shifted point spread function. A simulation study followed by experimental results for N = 2 and N = 3 is presented in this article.
data.title_cn: 使用编码相位孔径进行单次非相干成像，具有扩展和工程视场
data.abstract_cn: 许多应用都需要光学系统的大视场，而由于相机传感器的尺寸有限，高放大倍率的光学系统通常会受到视场的限制。这项研究提出了一种在不影响放大倍率的情况下设计光学系统视场的新技术。在所提出的方法中，通过在成像系统中引入编码相位掩模（CPM），将物体响应模式记录在相机上。编码相位掩模是 N 个不同散射相位的复用，其中 N − 1 表示要带入视场的孤立物体区域的数量。每个散射阶段都会产生相机上独特的稀疏点图案的点扩散函数。随着编码相位掩模的引入，物体的图像被带到相机传感器的区域内，如果没有 CPM，该区域将保留在系统的固有视场之外。为了重建具有位于各自位置的 N 个对象的原始对象平面，零填充对象响应模式与系统的零填充和移位点扩散函数进行去卷积。本文介绍了 N = 2 和 N = 3 的模拟研究以及实验结果。

data.title: Efficient and sustainable nanocatalyst based on dithiocarbamate ionic liquid functionalized magnetic graphene oxide for green synthesis of 1,4-dihydropyridins
data.author: Reza Ghorbannia, Robabeh Baharfar, Behrooz Maleki
data.summary: The design of catalytic systems that simultaneously achieve high activity, durability, and recyclability remains a central challenge in green and sustainable chemistry. To address the inherent limitations of conventional homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysts, we report a multifunctional nanocatalyst comprising dithiocarbamate-functionalized ionic liquids supported on magnetic graphene oxide (MGO-IL-DTC). In this architecture, magnetic graphene oxide provides a high surface area and facile magnetic recovery, ionic liquids create tunable ionic microenvironments, and dithiocarbamate moieties introduce electron-rich coordination sites. The synergistic interplay of these components affords superior catalytic activity, remarkable stability, and straightforward reusability. The catalyst structure was confirmed using Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), elemental analysis, vibrating sample magnetometer (VSM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD), energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS), and EDS mapping. The nanocatalyst efficiently promoted the synthesis of 1,4-dihydropyridine (1,4-DHP) derivatives from aromatic aldehydes, dimedone, β-ketoesters, and ammonium acetate in ethanol under mild conditions, affording high yields (85–95%) within 10–15 min. Moreover, the catalyst could be magnetically recovered and reused for at least five consecutive cycles without appreciable loss of activity. These findings highlight MGO-IL-DTC as a robust and modular platform for sustainable catalytic applications, aligning with the principles of green chemistry.
data.title_cn: 基于二硫代氨基甲酸盐离子液体功能化磁性氧化石墨烯的高效可持续纳米催化剂用于绿色合成1,4-二氢吡啶
data.abstract_cn: 同时实现高活性、耐用性和可回收性的催化系统的设计仍然是绿色和可持续化学的核心挑战。为了解决传统均相和非均相催化剂的固有局限性，我们报道了一种多功能纳米催化剂，包含负载在磁性氧化石墨烯（MGO-IL-DTC）上的二硫代氨基甲酸酯功能化离子液体。在这种结构中，磁性氧化石墨烯提供了高表面积和容易的磁恢复，离子液体创造了可调节的离子微环境，二硫代氨基甲酸酯部分引入了富电子配位位点。这些组分的协同相互作用提供了卓越的催化活性、卓越的稳定性和简单的可重复使用性。使用傅里叶变换红外光谱（FT-IR）、热重分析（TGA）、元素分析、振动样品磁强计（VSM）、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、X射线衍射（XRD）、能谱（EDS）和EDS图谱确认了催化剂结构。该纳米催化剂在温和条件下有效促进了芳香醛、双甲酮、β-酮酯和乙酸铵在乙醇中合成1,4-二氢吡啶（1,4-DHP）衍生物，并在10-15分钟内获得了高产率（85-95%）。此外，催化剂可以磁力回收并重复使用至少五个连续循环，而不会明显损失活性。这些发现凸显了 MGO-IL-DTC 作为可持续催化应用的强大模块化平台，符合绿色化学原则。

data.title: A hybrid learning framework for automated multiclass electrocardiogram classification with SimCardioNet
data.author: Muhammad Dawood Majid, Muhammad Anwar, Syed Fakhar Bilal, Muzammil Hussain, Muhammad Zubair, Jabeen Sultana, Muhammad Asif Habib
data.summary: Electrocardiography is a cornerstone in the diagnosis of cardiovascular diseases; however, accurate interpretation demands expert knowledge and is often impeded by data scarcity and annotation costs. To address these challenges, we propose SimCardioNet, a hybrid self-supervised and supervised deep learning framework for multi-class electrocardiography image classification. SimCardioNet leverages a custom multi-scale convolutional neural network backbone enhanced with residual connections and multi-head self-attention, pretrained via a modified SimCLR contrastive learning strategy that integrates a hybrid loss combining InfoNCE and cosine similarity. Following self-supervised pretraining, the model undergoes supervised fine-tuning with progressive layer unfreezing to mitigate overfitting and preserve meaningful representations. We evaluate SimCardioNet across three distinct ECG image datasets: (1) a 4-class Pakistani clinical ECG dataset (Dataset I), (2) an external Kaggle electrocardiography dataset for out-of-distribution validation (Dataset II), and (3) the large-scale PTB-XL benchmark (Dataset III) covering five diagnostic superclasses. On Dataset I, SimCardioNet achieves 0.975 accuracy, 0.973 precision, 0.973 recall, and 0.972 F1-score under 3-fold cross-validation. On Dataset II, the model demonstrates perfect classification performance (1.00 accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score), highlighting strong generalization. On the PTB-XL dataset (Dataset III), SimCardioNet attains 0.921 accuracy and 0.921 F1-score, outperforming current state-of-the-art models including dual-branch CNNs, entropy-enhanced CNNs, and Bi-GRU architectures. Ablation studies confirm the critical contributions of self-supervised pretraining, attention mechanisms, and domain-specific augmentations. Grad-CAM visualizations further validate the model’s focus on clinically relevant Electrocardiography regions. Our results underscore SimCardioNet’s potential to reduce reliance on labeled data while delivering robust, interpretable, and clinically viable Electrocardiography classification especially valuable in resource-constrained settings.
data.title_cn: 使用 SimCardioNet 进行自动多类心电图分类的混合学习框架
data.abstract_cn: 心电图是诊断心血管疾病的基石；然而，准确的解释需要专业知识，并且常常受到数据稀缺和注释成本的阻碍。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 SimCardioNet，这是一种用于多类心电图图像分类的混合自监督和监督深度学习框架。 SimCardioNet 利用定制的多尺度卷积神经网络主干，通过残差连接和多头自注意力增强，并通过改进的 SimCLR 对比学习策略进行预训练，该策略集成了 InfoNCE 和余弦相似性相结合的混合损失。在自我监督的预训练之后，模型会通过渐进层解冻进行监督微调，以减轻过度拟合并保留有意义的表示。我们在三个不同的心电图图像数据集上评估 SimCardioNet：(1) 4 类巴基斯坦临床心电图数据集（数据集 I），(2) 用于分布外验证的外部 Kaggle 心电图数据集（数据集 II），以及 (3) 涵盖五个诊断超类的大规模 PTB-XL 基准（数据集 III）。在数据集 I 上，SimCardioNet 在 3 倍交叉验证下实现了 0.975 准确率、0.973 精度、0.973 召回率和 0.972 F1 分数。在数据集 II 上，该模型展示了完美的分类性能（准确率、精确度、召回率和 F1 分数均为 1.00），突出了强大的泛化能力。在 PTB-XL 数据集（数据集 III）上，SimCardioNet 达到 0.921 的准确度和 0.921 F1 分数，优于当前最先进的模型，包括双分支 CNN、熵增强 CNN 和 Bi-GRU 架构。消融研究证实了自我监督预训练、注意力机制和特定领域增强的关键贡献。 Grad-CAM 可视化进一步验证了该模型对临床相关心电图区域的关注。我们的结果强调了 SimCardioNet 有潜力减少对标记数据的依赖，同时提供可靠、可解释且临床可行的心电图分类，在资源有限的环境中尤其有价值。

data.title: Numerical robustness of COVID-19 model with Lyapunov stability analysis
data.author: Ambika Pandey, Surath Ghosh
data.summary: In this research, a three-dimensional non-linear dynamical behavior of the COVID-19 pandemic model is described using fractional calculus. This model was presented by using the Caputo operators. Actually, a three-compartment fractional-order model of COVID-19 is considered, where A(t) denotes newly reported cases, B(t) represents severe infections, and C(t) represents daily deaths. The model is formulated using the Caputo derivative of fractional order $$(\eta \in (0,1])$$, which incorporates memory effects and allows us to capture delays and long-term persistence in epidemic dynamics. Numerical experiments show that reducing $$(\eta )$$ strengthens memory and can suppress oscillations or chaotic outbreaks. Parameter values and initial conditions are obtained from publicly available COVID-19 data (Johns Hopkins CSSE database and National Health Commission of China), ensuring biological relevance of the simulations. We investigated the existence and uniqueness of the COVID-19 pandemic model and the conditions under which it provides the uniqueness of the solution. We calculated the equilibrium points and exhibited the stability of the suggested model. Also, for numerical simulation, the Toufik-Atangana method is used. The Toufik–Atangana scheme is adopted because it employs piecewise linear interpolation that ensures stability and accuracy for stiff, nonlinear fractional-order systems, while preserving the memory effect inherent in the Caputo derivative. Its proven effectiveness in fractional epidemic and ecological models makes it particularly suitable for capturing the complex dynamics of COVID-19. The simulated results are analyzed and interpreted in detail, and show that the proposed approaches are innovative and trustworthy. The approach is innovative as it integrates fractional modeling with Lyapunov stability, bifurcation, and chaos analysis within a single framework, and trustworthy because it reliably captures both stable and unstable dynamics of the system without numerical divergence or instability. The approach is computationally efficient and straightforward to implement. In this work, numerical robustness highlights the ability of this scheme to generate stable and accurate solutions of the COVID-19 model even when the system shows nonlinear or chaotic behavior. Bifurcation analysis and graphic representations offer more insight into the suggested model, in addition to identifying the direction, stability, and bifurcation of the COVID-19 model.
data.title_cn: 利用 Lyapunov 稳定性分析的 COVID-19 模型的数值鲁棒性
data.abstract_cn: 在这项研究中，使用分数阶微积分描述了 COVID-19 大流行模型的三维非线性动态行为。该模型是通过使用 Caputo 算子提出的。实际上，考虑了 COVID-19 的三室分数阶模型，其中 A(t) 表示新报告病例，B(t) 表示严重感染，C(t) 表示每日死亡人数。该模型是使用分数阶Caputo导数$$(\eta \in (0,1])$$制定的，它结合了记忆效应，使我们能够捕获流行病动态中的延迟和长期持续性。数值实验表明，减少$$(\eta )$$可以增强记忆，可以抑制振荡或混乱的爆发。参数值和初始条件是从公开的COVID-19数据（约翰·霍普金斯CSSE数据库和中国国家卫生健康委员会）中获得的，确保生物我们研究了 COVID-19 大流行模型的存在性和唯一性，以及它提供解的唯一性的条件。此外，对于数值模拟，采用了 Toufik-Atangana 方法，因为它采用分段线性插值，可确保刚性、非线性分数阶系统的稳定性和准确性，同时保留了 Caputo 导数固有的记忆效应。分数流行病和生态模型的有效性使其特别适合捕获 COVID-19 的复杂动态，并表明该方法是创新且值得信赖的，因为它将分数建模与李亚普诺夫稳定性、分岔和混沌分析集成在一个框架内，并且可靠，因为它可靠地捕获了系统的稳定和不稳定动态，而没有数值分歧或不稳定性。鲁棒性凸显了该方案即使在系统表现出非线性或混沌行为时也能生成稳定且准确的 COVID-19 模型解决方案的能力。除了识别 COVID-19 模型的方向、稳定性和分叉之外，分叉分析和图形表示还可以更深入地了解建议的模型。

data.title: Prevalence of complementary and alternative medicine use among osteoarthritis patients in a developing country and their level of satisfaction
data.author: Mohammed Jaber, Waad Hamza, Tareq Abu Asab, Dania Abuhalima, Ahmad Hanani, Mazen Abdallah, Mohammad M. Jaber, Sa’ed H. Zyoud
data.summary: Complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) refers to nonconventional methods used to treat diseases and has been gaining global acceptance, including in Palestine. The growing interest in CAM and its various modalities highlights the need to understand its prevalence, types, and associated patient satisfaction among osteoarthritis (OA) patients. A cross-sectional study was conducted among OA patients attending hospitals in the study setting. Eligible participants were interviewed face-to-face via a structured questionnaire adapted from a previous regional study and developed on the basis of a comprehensive literature review. The data collected included sociodemographic characteristics, CAM use, and satisfaction levels. Of the 399 participants, 252 (63.2%) reported using CAM for OA management. Commonly used therapies include herbal medicine (49.9%), dietary supplements (26.6%), and various forms of prophetic medicine. Most CAM users reported a noticeable level of satisfaction with the therapies they used. CAM use is prevalent among OA patients in northern Palestine. This highlights the need to increase public awareness of CAM practices and their potential interactions with conventional treatments. Healthcare providers should stay informed about CAM options to guide patients appropriately. Further research is needed to establish stronger evidence regarding the efficacy and safety of CAM.
data.title_cn: 发展中国家骨关节炎患者补充和替代药物的使用率及其满意度
data.abstract_cn: 补充和替代医学（CAM）是指用于治疗疾病的非常规方法，并已获得包括巴勒斯坦在内的全球认可。人们对 CAM 及其各种治疗方式日益浓厚的兴趣，凸显了了解其在骨关节炎 (OA) 患者中的患病率、类型和相关患者满意度的必要性。在研究环境中的医院就诊的 OA 患者中进行了一项横断面研究。通过根据之前的区域研究改编并在综合文献综述的基础上制定的结构化调查问卷，对符合条件的参与者进行了面对面访谈。收集的数据包括社会人口特征、CAM 使用和满意度。在 399 名参与者中，252 名 (63.2%) 报告使用 CAM 进行 OA 管理。常用的疗法包括草药（49.9%）、膳食补充剂（26.6%）和各种形式的预言医学。大多数 CAM 用户对他们使用的疗法表示非常满意。巴勒斯坦北部 OA 患者普遍使用 CAM。这凸显了提高公众对 CAM 实践及其与传统治疗的潜在相互作用的认识的必要性。医疗保健提供者应随时了解 CAM 选项，以适当指导患者。需要进一步研究来建立关于 CAM 有效性和安全性的更有力证据。

data.title: CDK2 inhibition promotes neuronal differentiation in neuroblastoma
data.author: Mohammad Alzrigat, Loay Mahmoud, Ada Nursel Topçu, Marta Valenti, Lu Zhang, Puck Veen, Fabian John, Wesam Bazzar, Kaisa Lehti, Lars-Gunnar Larsson
data.summary: Neuroblastoma (NB) is a childhood tumor arising from neural crest-derived progenitor cells. Cyclin dependent kinase 2 (CDK2) has been suggested to be a promising therapeutic target in NB especially MYCN-amplified tumors. How CDK2 contributes to the development of NB is not fully understood. Here, we demonstrate that high CDK2 expression in NB correlates with advanced and high-risk disease, MYCN-amplification, poor prognosis, and undifferentiated tumors. We uncovered that CDK2 genetic or pharmacological inhibition induces neuronal differentiation in human NB cell lines, which effect is in general more prominent in the MYCN-amplified subtype. Further, we establish CDK2 as a MYCN target gene that modulate the MYC-pathway in MYCN-amplified NB. Notably, pharmacological inhibition of CDK2 in combination with MYCN inhibition or all-trans-retinoic acid (ATRA) differentiation therapy enhances neuronal differentiation in vitro. These results reveal an important function of CDK2 in NB and highlight CDK2 inhibition alone or in combination with MYC inhibitors and retinoids as a potential strategy for differentiation therapy in NB.
data.title_cn: CDK2 抑制促进神经母细胞瘤中的神经元分化
data.abstract_cn: 神经母细胞瘤（NB）是一种由神经嵴衍生祖细胞产生的儿童肿瘤。细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶 2 (CDK2) 被认为是 NB 特别是 MYCN 扩增肿瘤的有前途的治疗靶点。 CDK2 如何促进 NB 的发展尚不完全清楚。在这里，我们证明 NB 中的高 CDK2 表达与晚期和高风险疾病、MYCN 扩增、预后不良和未分化肿瘤相关。我们发现 CDK2 遗传或药理学抑制可诱导人 NB 细胞系中的神经元分化，这种效应通常在 MYCN 扩增亚型中更为突出。此外，我们将 CDK2 确立为 MYCN 靶基因，可调节 MYCN 扩增的 NB 中的 MYC 通路。值得注意的是，CDK2 的药理学抑制与 MYCN 抑制或全反式视黄酸 (ATRA) 分化疗法相结合可增强体外神经元分化。这些结果揭示了 CDK2 在 NB 中的重要功能，并强调单独抑制 CDK2 或与 MYC 抑制剂和类视黄醇联合抑制 CDK2 作为 NB 分化治疗的潜在策略。

data.title: Dynamics of soliton propagation: bifurcation, chaos, and quantitative insights into the modified Camassa–Holm equation
data.author: Md. Nur Alam, Shams Forruque Ahmed, Hajar F. Ismael, Mitiku Daba Firdi, Irfan Anjum Badruddin, Syed Javed
data.summary: Abstract The modified Camassa–Holm (MCH) equation is a significant mathematical model for describing nonlinear wave phenomena, especially in shallow water dynamics and related physical systems. Although various analytical techniques have been applied to such nonlinear equations, many difficulties have arisen in producing a wide variety of exact and structurally rich solutions. This study addresses this gap by employing the modified (G′/G)-expansion (MG′/GE) method to construct an extensive range of exact traveling wave solutions for the MCH framework, such as trigonometric, hyperbolic, and rational solutions. Numerous waveforms, including single singular, double singular, multiple bright, multiple dark, multiple singular, and singular solitons, have been found to have solutions for the MCH framework. These waveforms have numerous applications in applied sciences and engineering. The structural properties and propagation dynamics of the resulting solutions are successfully depicted by graphics such as 3D, contour, density, 2D time-evolution, and 3D revolving plots. Compared to other existing approaches, such as the sine–cosine method and the tanh method, the MG’/GE approach is substantially more accurate and adaptable. The MG’/GE technique’s durability and computing efficiency allow it to generate precise findings straightforwardly. Its broad variety of applications in nonlinear system analysis is further highlighted by its expansion to fractional-order equations. In addition to laying the foundation for future research on traveling wave phenomena in many scientific domains, the current study presents an analytical scheme for both classical and fractional nonlinear evolution equations (NLEEs).
data.title_cn: 孤子传播动力学：分岔、混沌以及对修正卡马萨-霍尔姆方程的定量见解
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 修正的卡马萨-霍尔姆（MCH）方程是描述非线性波浪现象的重要数学模型，特别是在浅水动力学和相关物理系统中。尽管各种分析技术已应用于此类非线性方程，但在产生各种精确且结构丰富的解时出现了许多困难。本研究通过采用改进的 (G′/G) 展开 (MG′/GE) 方法来为 MCH 框架构建广泛的精确行波解，例如三角解、双曲解和有理解，从而解决了这一差距。已经发现许多波形，包括单奇异、双奇异、多重亮、多重暗、多重奇异和奇异孤子，都具有 MCH 框架的解决方案。这些波形在应用科学和工程中具有广泛的应用。由此产生的解决方案的结构特性和传播动力学可以通过 3D、轮廓、密度、2D 时间演化和 3D 旋转图等图形成功地描述。与其他现有方法（例如正弦余弦方法和 tanh 方法）相比，MG’/GE 方法更加准确且适应性更强。 MG’/GE 技术的耐用性和计算效率使其能够直接生成精确的结果。它对分数阶方程的扩展进一步凸显了它在非线性系统分析中的广泛应用。除了为未来许多科学领域的行波现象研究奠定基础之外，当前的研究还提出了经典和分数非线性演化方程（NLEE）的分析方案。

data.title: Time trends in psychosomatic symptoms among Hungarian youth using repeated cross sectional HBSC data from 2002 to 2022
data.author: Mária Klein, Dóra Várnai, Ágnes Németh, Zsolt Horváth, Gyöngyi Kökönyei
data.summary: Abstract Psychosomatic symptoms have become increasingly prevalent among adolescents; however, trends covering a longer period remain underexplored in Hungary. This study examines changes in psychosomatic symptoms among school-aged children using nationally representative data from the Hungarian Health Behaviour in School-aged Children (HBSC) survey, collected in 2002, 2006, 2010, 2014, 2018, and 2022 (N = 37,930; M age = 14.88 years, SD age = 2.36 years; boys = 49.3%). Descriptive statistics, logistic regression analyses, and ANCOVAs were conducted to assess trends from 2002 to 2022. Girls and older adolescents reported more symptoms overall, with 2022 showing the highest prevalence across all symptom categories in both genders. The proportion of adolescents reporting multiple health complaints (MHC) (excluding fatigue) became considerably more common between 2010 and 2022, increasing from 40.6 to 65.6% among girls, and from 30.2 to 42% among boys. Fatigue emerged as the most reported frequent symptom across all survey waves among both genders, peaking in 2022 at 47.5% among boys and 67.6% among girls. The findings point to a trajectory—particularly in recent years—highlighting the urgent need for targeted interventions and policy actions to support adolescent health.
data.title_cn: 使用 2002 年至 2022 年重复横截面 HBSC 数据得出匈牙利青年心身症状的时间趋势
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 心身症状在青少年中越来越普遍。然而，匈牙利的较长时期趋势仍未得到充分探索。本研究使用 2002 年、2006 年、2010 年、2014 年、2018 年和 2022 年收集的匈牙利学龄儿童健康行为 (HBSC) 调查的全国代表性数据，探讨了学龄儿童心身症状的变化（N = 37,930；M 年龄 = 14.88 岁，SD 年龄 = 2.36 岁；男孩 = 49.3%）。通过描述性统计、逻辑回归分析和ANCOVA来评估2002年至2022年的趋势。女孩和年龄较大的青少年总体上报告了更多的症状，2022年显示男女所有症状类别的患病率最高。 2010 年至 2022 年间，报告多种健康主诉 (MHC)（不包括疲劳）的青少年比例变得更加普遍，女孩从 40.6% 增加到 65.6%，男孩从 30.2% 增加到 42%。在所有调查浪潮中，疲劳成为男女中最常见的症状，在 2022 年达到峰值，男孩中疲劳的比例为 47.5%，女孩中疲劳的比例为 67.6%。研究结果指出了一个轨迹——尤其是近年来——强调迫切需要采取有针对性的干预措施和政策行动来支持青少年健康。

data.title: Hyperparameter optimization to enhance the performance of deep learning models for the early detection of invasive turtles in Korea
data.author: Jong-Won Baek, Jung-Il Kim, Min-Ho Mun, Chang-Bae Kim
data.summary: Abstract Invasive freshwater turtles are major drivers of biodiversity loss, underscoring the importance of early detection and management. However, it is challenging for experts to manually monitor a broad geographic area, necessitating support tools. Deep learning-based object detection models have displayed high performance in automating wildlife monitoring tasks. Furthermore, hyperparameter optimization, including optimizer selection and hyperparameter tuning, might further enhance performance by optimizing training settings to the dataset. In this study, an optimized model was developed to apply hyperparameter optimization to detect and classify six invasive turtle species in Korea from images. The optimized model was compared to a default model trained using the default optimizer and hyperparameters. The optimized model outperformed the default model, as indicated by the evaluations of mean average precision using a fixed intersection over union threshold of 0.5 (0.973 vs. 0.959) and a range of thresholds ranging from 0.5 to 0.95 (0.841 vs. 0.815). The classification accuracy of the optimized model reached 92.7%, exceeding that of the default model (89.9%). These findings highlight the utility of hyperparameter optimization and suggest that the proposed approach can support the early detection of invasive turtles, thereby enhancing to invasive species management.
data.title_cn: 超参数优化可增强深度学习模型的性能，以早期检测韩国的入侵海龟
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 入侵淡水龟是生物多样性丧失的主要驱动因素，这凸显了早期发现和管理的重要性。然而，对于专家来说，手动监控广泛的地理区域具有挑战性，因此需要支持工具。基于深度学习的目标检测模型在自动化野生动物监测任务方面表现出了高性能。此外，超参数优化，包括优化器选择和超参数调整，可以通过优化数据集的训练设置来进一步提高性能。在这项研究中，开发了一个优化模型，应用超参数优化从图像中检测和分类韩国的六种入侵海龟物种。将优化后的模型与使用默认优化器和超参数训练的默认模型进行比较。优化模型优于默认模型，如使用 0.5 的并集阈值（0.973 与 0.959）的固定交集以及 0.5 到 0.95 的阈值范围（0.841 与 0.815）对平均精度的评估所示。优化后模型的分类准确率达到92.7%，超过默认模型的分类准确率（89.9%）。这些发现强调了超参数优化的实用性，并表明所提出的方法可以支持入侵海龟的早期检测，从而加强入侵物种管理。

data.title: Enhanced meropenem activity by a microbiome derived peptide targeting oxacillinase 48 carbapenemase in carbapenem resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates
data.author: Solmaz Sadeghi, Mohammad Ali Faramarzi, Maryam Siroosi
data.summary: Carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales, particularly those producing oxacillinase 48 (OXA-48) carbapenemase (blaOXA−48), pose a critical global health threat, especially in the Middle East where its prevalence is remarkably high. The lack of specific OXA-48 inhibitors and the emergence of resistance even to avibactam highlight the urgent need for novel therapeutic strategies. This study investigated the peptide M104 as an adjunctive agent to meropenem against multidrug-resistant (including meropenem-resistant) blaOXA−48 positive Klebsiella pneumoniae clinical isolates. Peptide M104 at the concentration of 125 µg/mL enhanced meropenem’s antibacterial activity against all ten tested blaOXA−48 positive isolates and significantly reduced the meropenem minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) values at least two-fold for all ten clinical isolates (p-value < 0.002). This enhancement was not observed in blaOXA−48 negative isolates, and the peptide showed no intrinsic antibacterial activity. In strong biofilm-forming isolates, M104 reduced meropenem’s minimum biofilm inhibitory concentrations (MBIC) by two-fold, although this reduction was not statistically significant (p-value = 0.06), and showed limited meropenem enhancement in reducing minimum biofilm eradication concentration (MBEC). Cytotoxicity assays revealed that M104 at 200 µg/mL did not reduce HDFa cell viability after 24 h, and the peptide also showed no hemolytic activity at this concentration. These findings suggest peptide M104 is a candidate OXA-48 inhibitor, capable of enhancing meropenem’s efficacy against carbapenem-resistant K. pneumoniae infections, while showing limited cytotoxicity and no hemolytic effects. Further validation using a larger number of clinical isolates and in vivo studies is needed to confirm these results and support peptide M104 as the first peptide inhibitor of OXA-48 carbapenemase.
data.title_cn: 靶向苯唑西林酶 48 碳青霉烯酶的微生物组衍生肽可增强碳青霉烯类耐药肺炎克雷伯菌分离株中的美罗培南活性
data.abstract_cn: 耐碳青霉烯类肠杆菌，特别是那些产生苯唑西林酶 48 (OXA-48) 碳青霉烯酶 (blaOXA−48) 的肠杆菌，对全球健康构成严重威胁，特别是在其患病率非常高的中东地区。特异性 OXA-48 抑制剂的缺乏以及甚至对阿维巴坦的耐药性的出现凸显了对新治疗策略的迫切需要。本研究调查了肽 M104 作为美罗培南的辅助药物对抗多重耐药（包括美罗培南耐药）blaOXA−48 阳性肺炎克雷伯菌临床分离株。浓度为 125 µg/mL 的肽 M104 增强了美罗培南对所有 10 个测试的 blaOXA−48 阳性分离株的抗菌活性，并显着降低了所有 10 个临床分离株的美罗培南最低抑菌浓度 (MIC) 值至少两倍（p 值 < 0.002）。在 blaOXA−48 阴性分离株中没有观察到这种增强，并且该肽没有表现出内在的抗菌活性。在强生物膜形成分离株中，M104 将美罗培南的最低生物膜抑制浓度 (MBIC) 降低两倍，尽管这种降低没有统计学意义 (p 值 = 0.06)，并且在降低最低生物膜根除浓度 (MBEC) 方面显示出有限的美罗培南增强作用。细胞毒性测定表明，200 µg/mL 的 M104 在 24 小时后不会降低 HDFa 细胞活力，并且该肽在此浓度下也没有表现出溶血活性。这些发现表明，肽 M104 是一种候选 OXA-48 抑制剂，能够增强美罗培南对抗碳青霉烯类耐药肺炎克雷伯菌感染的功效，同时表现出有限的细胞毒性且无溶血作用。需要使用大量临床分离株和体内研究进行进一步验证，以确认这些结果并支持肽 M104 作为 OXA-48 碳青霉烯酶的第一个肽抑制剂。

data.title: Hydrothermal synthesis of ZnO nanoparticles from recycled ZnO obtained from electric Arc furnace dust: morphology control and applications
data.author: Sirunya Somla, Tanongsak Yingnakorn, Thanapon Chandakhiaw, Chaiyasit Longbutsri, Loeslakkhana Sriklang, Sakhob Khumkoa
data.summary: This study presents a sustainable, value-added approach to synthesizing high-quality zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO NPs) by utilizing ZnO recovered from industrial electric arc furnace dust (EAFD) waste. The integrated two-stage process involved selective acid leaching for precursor purification, followed by hydrothermal synthesis for morphology control. Optimized leaching using 2 M H2SO4 achieved a high zinc recovery rate of over 90% while effectively minimizing lead contamination. Subsequently, key hydrothermal parameters—including pH (7–12), temperature 100–200 °C, reaction time (1–24 h), and NaOH concentration (0.5–6 M)—were systematically varied. This optimization successfully produced ZnO NPs with diverse, tunable morphologies, including nanorods, nanoplates, and nanogranules. XRD confirmed the high crystallinity and phase purity (wurtzite structure), and UV-Visible spectroscopy showed a strong UV absorption with a calculated band gap of 3.34 eV. The antibacterial activity revealed that the nanoplate morphology produced a larger inhibition zone than the nanorod against both Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli. These findings demonstrate the viability of upcycling industrial waste into high-performance, morphology-controlled nanomaterials, paving the way for sustainable and environmentally friendly production.
data.title_cn: 从电弧炉粉尘中回收的 ZnO 水热合成 ZnO 纳米粒子：形态控制和应用
data.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了一种可持续的、增值的方法，利用从工业电弧炉粉尘 (EAFD) 废物中回收的 ZnO 来合成高质量氧化锌纳米颗粒 (ZnO NP)。集成的两阶段工艺包括选择性酸浸以进行前体纯化，然后进行水热合成以进行形态控制。使用 2 M H2SO4 进行优化浸出，锌回收率高达 90% 以上，同时有效减少铅污染。随后，系统地改变了关键的水热参数，包括 pH (7-12)、温度 100-200 °C、反应时间 (1-24 小时) 和 NaOH 浓度 (0.5-6 M)。这种优化成功地生产了具有多种、可调形貌的 ZnO 纳米颗粒，包括纳米棒、纳米板和纳米颗粒。 XRD 证实了其高结晶度和相纯度（纤锌矿结构），紫外-可见光谱显示出强烈的紫外吸收，计算出的带隙为 3.34 eV。抗菌活性表明，纳米板形态对金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌产生了比纳米棒更大的抑制区。这些发现证明了将工业废物升级改造为高性能、形态可控的纳米材料的可行性，为可持续和环保生产铺平了道路。
